summary: Spotify Technology S.A. filed a Form 6-K containing interim condensed consolidated financial statements for the quarter ended March 31, 2026. The filing is a routine periodic report under the 1934 Act, reflects standard quarterly results—revenue EUR4,533M, net income EUR721M, basic EPS EUR3.50—and includes financial position, cash flows, and MD&A. No special-situation event (acquisition, divestiture, tender, restructuring, etc.) is disclosed. The filing is strictly a financial update; it does not trigger any special situation classification.
